answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI to reserve 1,000 units to secure a unique operational slot, similar to a falcon patrolling its territory. A global verifier monitors ledger occupancy to ensure no double-committed identities reach the zenith of influence, rejecting any overlaps. While an honest agent pays 1,000 units, an attacker deploying 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 unit penalty. Any evidence of identity fraud streaks like a comet across the registry, triggering a mandatory 180-day forfeiture of all locked funds to maintain system integrity.
